{{Quote|Tonight we march on the town of Bin to avenge the Battle of Zehava. Our supplies have been depleted. Our weapons are low. Most of us died in the glorious battle to retake our beloved city of Zehava from the ruthless Daan. There is no chance that our battle will succeed, yet we will fight for justice and vengeance against the enemy who persecutes us.|[[Hologram/Legends|Hologram]] of Pinani|<ref name="Jedi Apprentice: The Defenders of the Dead">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Defenders of the Dead]]''</ref>}}
The '''Battle of Bin''' occurred at some point between the [[Twenty-First Battle of Zehava]] circa [[94 BBY/Legends|94 BBY]] and the [[Twenty-Second Battle of Zehava]] three years later. It was one of the many struggles of the [[Melida/Daan/Legends|Melida/Daan]] Civil War. [[Pinani]] died during that battle in an attempt to avenge her husband [[Quintama]]'s [[Death/Legends|death]].
